name: aws_backend
description: This package provides AWS DynamoDB storage services for the Dart SLTT (Sign Language Translation Tool) system, optimized for serverless deployment with minimal cold start time.

scripts.build:linux: rm -f bootstrap && dart compile exe bin/bootstrap.dart -o bootstrap && chmod +x bootstrap
scripts.deploy:sltt-dart-prd:shared-infra: npx serverless deploy --config serverless-shared-infra.yml --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --verbose && npm run setup:ssm-parameters && npm run setup:ssm-resource-policies && npm run setup:ssm-cross-account-access:dev
scripts.setup:ssm-cross-account-access:dev: node scripts/setup_target_account_ssm_access.js --target-profile sltt-dart-dev --principal=user:epyle-sltt-dart --shared-account 379334555674 --stage prd --region us-east-1 && node scripts/setup_target_account_ssm_access.js --target-profile sltt-dart-dev --principal=role:sltt-secondary-infra-dev-us-east-1-lambdaRole --shared-account 379334555674 --stage prd --region us-east-1
scripts.deploy:sltt-dart-prd:secondary:dev: npm run setup:auth-email-mode:sltt-dart-prd:dev:ses && npm run ensure-auth-secrets:sltt-dart-prd && node scripts/deploy_secondary_with_git_info.js --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --verbose
scripts.deploy:sltt-dart-dev:secondary:dev: npm run setup:auth-email-mode:sltt-dart-dev:dev:log && node scripts/deploy_secondary_with_git_info.js --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev --verbose
scripts.deploy:sltt-dart-prd:secondary:prod: npm run setup:auth-email-mode:sltt-dart-prd:prod:ses && npm run ensure-auth-secrets:sltt-dart-prd && node scripts/deploy_secondary_with_git_info.js --stage prod --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --verbose
scripts.setup:auth-email-mode:sltt-dart-dev:dev:: node scripts/setup_ssm_parameters.js --auth-only true --shared-infra-stage prd --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev --auth-stage dev --auth-email-mode log --aws-region us-east-1
scripts.setup:auth-email-mode:sltt-dart-prd:prod: node scripts/setup_ssm_parameters.js --auth-only true --shared-infra-stage prd --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --auth-stage prod --auth-email-mode ses --aws-region us-east-1
scripts.setup:auth-email-mode:sltt-dart-prd:dev:: node scripts/setup_ssm_parameters.js --auth-only true --shared-infra-stage prd --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --auth-stage dev --auth-email-mode ses --aws-region us-east-1
scripts.ensure-jwt-secret:sltt-dart-prd: node scripts/ensure_auth_secret.js --profile sltt-dart-prd --stage prd --region us-east-1 --kind jwt
scripts.ensure-verification-code-secret:sltt-dar: node scripts/ensure_auth_secret.js --profile sltt-dart-prd --stage prd --region us-east-1 --kind verification-code
scripts.get-jwt-secret:sltt-dart-prd: node scripts/get_auth_secret.js --profile sltt-dart-prd --stage prd --region us-east-1 --kind jwt
scripts.get-verification-code-secret:sltt-dart-p: node scripts/get_auth_secret.js --profile sltt-dart-prd --stage prd --region us-east-1 --kind verification-code
scripts.update-jwt-secret:sltt-dart-prd: node scripts/update_auth_secret_from_file.js --profile sltt-dart-prd --stage prd --region us-east-1 --kind jwt
scripts.update-verification-code-secret:sltt-dar: node scripts/update_auth_secret_from_file.js --profile sltt-dart-prd --stage prd --region us-east-1 --kind verification-code
scripts.mirror:ssm-to-dev: node scripts/mirror_shared_ssm_to_target.js --source-profile sltt-dart-prd --target-profile sltt-dart-dev --stage prd --region us-east-1
scripts.logs:secondary:dev: npx serverless logs --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --function api --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev --startTime 1h
scripts.logs:secondary:tst: npx serverless logs --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --function api --stage tst --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev --startTime 1h
scripts.logs:secondary:sltt-backend:dev: npx serverless logs --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --function api --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --startTime 1h
scripts.logs:secondary:sltt-backend:dev:auth: aws logs tail /aws/lambda/sltt-secondary-infra-dev-api --since 1h --profile sltt-dart-prd --region us-east-1 --format short --filter-pattern Auth
scripts.logs:auth-events:dev: aws logs tail /aws/lambda/sltt-secondary-infra-dev-api --since 1h --profile sltt-dart-dev --region us-east-1 --format short --filter-pattern AuthEvent
scripts.logs:auth-events:tst: aws logs tail /aws/lambda/sltt-secondary-infra-tst-api --since 1h --profile sltt-dart-dev --region us-east-1 --format short --filter-pattern AuthEvent
scripts.logs:auth-events:prod: aws logs tail /aws/lambda/sltt-secondary-infra-prod-api --since 1h --profile sltt-dart-prd --region us-east-1 --format short --filter-pattern AuthEvent
scripts.info:secondary:dev: npx serverless info --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.info:secondary:tst: npx serverless info --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage tst --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.info:secondary:prod: npx serverless info --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage prod --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.cloudfront-url:shared: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name sltt-shared-infra-prd --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='MediaCloudFrontDomainName'].OutputValue" --output text --profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.cloudfront:public-key-set-ssm:tst: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/tst/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PUBLIC_KEY --type String --value file://../../../public_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:private-key-set-ssm:tst: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/tst/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY --type SecureString --value file://../../../private_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:public-key-set-ssm:dev: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/dev/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PUBLIC_KEY --type String --value file://../../../public_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:private-key-set-ssm:dev: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/dev/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY --type SecureString --value file://../../../private_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:public-key-set-ssm:prd: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/prd/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PUBLIC_KEY --type String --value file://../../../public_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.cloudfront:private-key-set-ssm:prd: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/prd/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY --type SecureString --value file://../../../private_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-prd
